basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent graduate based in New Jersey, currently exploring career opportunities in the IT and networking sectors. Despite my primary interest in technology, I have a diverse range of interests including community activism and exploring alternative lifestyles. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends when I'm not busy with job applications or attending meetups. Single and open to new experiences, I'm always looking to learn and engage with different communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Technology from George Washington University. While my formal education covered a broad spectrum of IT topics, I've been self-teaching myself Python and networking skills through online courses and forums. My curiosity has led me to explore various facets of IT, including emerging fields like DevOps.
